Senior Developer Advocate, RevenueCat

text: Open by framing monetization as product design, not extraction. This talk builds the whole path from value to durable access.
A great app with no business model is still a side project.
textPreview: A great app with no business model is still a side project.

text: Monetization is part of product design, not the thing you bolt on at launch.
textPreview: Monetization is part of product design, not the thing you bolt on at launch.

text: Many strong apps never become durable businesses because billing is postponed until launch week.

I help developers
make more money.

text: Keep the introduction short. Establish Android and subscription credibility, then continue.
Monetization is a system, not a checkout button.
textPreview: Monetization is a system, not a checkout button.

text: Model, catalog, identity, paywall, access, recovery, measurement.
textPreview: Model, catalog, identity, paywall, access, recovery, measurement.

text: This system framing is the backbone. A checkout button can work while the business still fails.

text:
Purchases.sharedInstance.restorePurchasesWith(
  onError = { error ->
    showRecoveryError(error)
  },
  onSuccess = { customerInfo ->
    val restored = customerInfo
      .entitlements["pro"]
      ?.isActive == true
    updateAccess(restored)
  }
)
Restore only from an explicit user action. Feed CustomerInfo through the same entitlement gate used after purchase.
